evaluation_protocol.area_definition: COCO default original-image bbox area ranges, IoU 0.50:0.95
notes: COCO area evaluation on converted VisDrone labels, not official VisDrone ignore regions.
Ultralytics AP and COCO AP_all are separate evaluators/prediction passes; do not mix them.
Batch val may use rectangular padding; area predict uses each 4-image chunk padding.
P/R are Ultralytics selected F1 operating point metrics, not P/R at conf=0.001.
Training built-in validation may use FP16 and double batch; final report is standalone FP32.

p2_architecture.variant: E19a = E17a controlled replacement: both FusionReadyAdapters become reliability-conditioned bounded 3x3 correlation alignment adapters
p2_architecture.alignment: masked zero-border sliced 3x3 candidates; no grid_sample/DCN/replicate-pad/torch.roll

tal2.note: Only matching chunk size changes from 1 to 2.

p2_architecture.claim_boundary: One E17a adapter-replacement experiment only; no E10a/E18a DSSG, E16a TSDR, DySample, PGALP, P3SDE or slicing

preflight_transfer.source: original 80-class yolo11s.pt transferred into deterministic E1, then every E1 tensor mapped exactly into E19a

source_audit.note: P2 fusion and P2 Detect are random; 10-class output layers are reinitialized.

preflight_transfer.note: No experiment best.pt is a parent. Only layers 12/16 RCFA and model.28.aux_head are newly initialized.

implementation.note: Only matching chunk size changes from 1 to 2.

matching_equivalence.limits: Synthetic FP32-GT cases and batch8 real-model 128px steps; not a 1024px memory test or a guarantee of identical final AP.

smoke_gate.note: Two full training epochs + builtin validation + full FP32/area evaluation. Not an accuracy result.

training.memory_note: PyTorch allocator peaks, including in-training validation; not whole-device usage.
training.comparison_note: Full forward batch unchanged; image-wise matching only. Training time/memory comparisons require the same matching implementation on both models.

pretrained_transfer.source: original 80-class yolo11s.pt transferred into deterministic E1, then every E1 tensor mapped exactly into E19a

source_audit.note: P2 fusion and P2 Detect are random; 10-class output layers are reinitialized.

pretrained_transfer.note: No experiment best.pt is a parent. Only layers 12/16 RCFA and model.28.aux_head are newly initialized.

validation.speed_note: Batched FP32 validation, NOT batch=1 deployment FPS.
